notes.title: All-In-One Sports 1.6.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/f92f8c362984ba560cdafe3e8188fbb13b7858c0.png[/img]

Hello players,
It’s been a while since our last update. Thank you so much for your patience and continued support!
The 1.6.1 update is now live, bringing exciting new content, improved gameplay mechanics, and important bug fixes.

[h3]Update Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Game Mode: 3-Cushion Billiards[/b]
A challenging and strategic billiards mode for experienced players.

[*] [b]Improved Bowling Physics[/b]
Enhanced realism in ball spin, friction, and pin collision.

[*] [b]Global Matchmaking Server Selection[/b]
Choose from multiple regions such as Asia, North America, and Europe for smoother gameplay and better connectivity.

[*] [b]Improved Ball Collision in Billiards[/b]
Fixed an issue where balls reacted before actual contact.

[*] [b]Updated Match Start Rules[/b]
The starting player is now chosen randomly instead of always defaulting to Player 1.
This provides a more balanced and fair multiplayer experience.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where Four-Ball Billiards Level 5 could not progress.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug where the support line remained visible after leveling up in billiards.[/b]
[/list]

We’re committed to improving your experience with each update.
Enjoy the new content and stay tuned for more!

– Appnori Team

notes.title: All-In-One Sports 1.6.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:

Hello, All-In-One Sports players!
We have released version 1.6.0 to improve your gameplay experience.
This update includes multiplayer improvements, adjustments and bug fixes for various sports, and new billiards DLC additions.

[h1][b]Update Details[/b][/h1]

[h3]Multiplayer Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the opponent's character would appear in an abnormal position if the player was outside the VR boundary before a multiplayer match started.
[/list]

[h3]Soccer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved controller responsiveness, making kicking the ball smoother and more accurate.
[/list]

[h3]Table Tennis[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

[h3]Tennis[/h3]
[list]

[*] Relaxed the camera movement restriction when the ball is sent far away from the opponent.
[*] Adjusted the force applied when hitting the ball.
[/list]

[h3]Bowling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved UI display.
[*] Adjusted the physics of bowling pins.
[/list]

[h2]New Billiards DLC Added[/h2]
Experience new and exciting billiards modes with our latest DLC!

[list]
[*] Four Ball Billiards: A new strategic billiards mode has been added.

Download the DLC now and enjoy a deeper billiards experience!

The update will be applied automatically, so please make sure you are playing the latest version.
We are committed to providing an even better sports experience for our players.
Thank you for your continued support!




Appnori. Team

notes.title: 1.4.1 Version Update Summary
notes.content:
[h1][b]Get Ready for the Ultimate VR Sports Experience![/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re thrilled to announce the release of three brand-new sports in the latest DLC for All In One Sports VR! [/h3]
This DLC brings a whole new level of excitement to All In One Sports VR. 
Whether you crave the intense discipline of combat sports or the adrenaline rush of team-based play, we’ve got you covered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/b362201896a9fcbc967ffb7baeea4c540bb1341b.png[/img]

Each of these new sports will challenge you in unique ways, offering fresh, immersive experiences designed to push your skills and keep the adrenaline pumping. 
This isn’t just an update—it’s a major expansion that adds even more excitement and variety to your favorite VR sports game.



[olist]



[h2][b] 1. KungFu [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/c849f18d19a66cb8b97e0cebeb077d51b825f0fd.png[/img]

Unleash your inner martial artist! 
Engage in intense sparring sessions, using real Kung Fu movements to block, deflect, and counter your opponent's attacks. 
Feel the precision and agility required as you train like a true master.



[h2][b] 2. Hockey [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/13f0a529e31a4aae26f8982bb4049ceaea14a510.png[/img]

Challenge yourself to a fast-paced air hockey game. 
Use the VR controller to control your paddle with pinpoint accuracy to block, attack, and dominate your opponents. 
The winning dash is just one puck away!


[h2][b] 3. Soccer [/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/32f4317cdbf5bd25e1c98d106697834cf7cc2829.png[/img]

Step into the ultimate VR soccer experience! 
Whether you're dribbling past defenders, making that perfect pass, or shooting for goal, this mode brings the thrill of the pitch right to your living room with ultra-realistic physics and immersive gameplay.

[/olist]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Version Update!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/efdb330b591d42be15eef7d4eb953cbbab7e26b3.jpg[/img]

[h1]1.3.0 Version Update!![/h1]

Hello, dear players!

We are excited to bring you a brand new update that will make your gaming experience even more diverse and enjoyable. In this update, we have added amazing Cosmetics for the tools and balls you need to play the game!

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[h2]Matching System Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Reduced Random Matching Wait Time[/h3]
If the wait time for random matching becomes too long, the system will now automatically match you with an AI opponent. Enjoy faster matchmaking for a seamless gaming experience.

[h2]Timeout Loss Penalty[/h2]
Players will automatically be considered defeated if they exceed the time limit twice during a game. This ensures smooth and fair gameplay.

[h2]New Tool Cosmetics[/h2]
Achieve various milestones in each category and earn new cosmetics! Enjoy a more exciting gameplay experience.
Equip the new Cosmetics and show off your amazing style in the game!

[b]examples:[/b]
Table Tennis: Score 100 points with smashes
Boxing: Knock down opponents 100 times
Archery: Win 10 shoot-offs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627236/e71078c3eac1fbdf05213b5fcf0d61636a30fe3f.png[/img]

[h3]Spectator Cheering Tools Update[/h3]
We have added two new cheering tools for spectators: the Lightsaber and Fireworks. Enhance your spectator mode experience by using these diverse cheering tools to show your support and excitement!

[/list]

[h1]Specific Game Updates[/h1]

[list]
[h2]Table Tennis[/h2]
[h3]Rally Scoring Rule Change[/h3]
During a rally, if the opponent hits the ball and it does not hit the table but you return it, the opponent will lose the point.
[h3]Serve Spin Adjustment[/h3]
The spin strength of serves has been reduced by 50%, making serves easier to handle.

[h2]Badminton[/h2]
[h3]Serve Rule Adjustment[/h3]
Previously, you had to hold the shuttlecock before serving, but now you can serve without holding it, allowing for more dynamic play.

[h2]Baseball[/h2]
Changed the pitching mechanics.

[h2]Darts[/h2]
Added a rule where a player loses if they timeout twice in a multiplayer game.

[h2]Billiards[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed the UI that shows ball-related information to make multiplayer games more challenging.
[*]Fixed the issue with the cue ball's hit point location.
[*]Restored the missing trackpad movements.
[*]Added a rule where a player loses if they timeout twice in a multiplayer game.
[/list]

[h2]Boxing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a vibration animation when the health bar decreases.
[*]Improved the camera tracking of the health bar for smoother movement.
[/list]

[/list]

We strive to provide a more enjoyable and seamless gaming experience by incorporating your feedback. Discover the new features and improvements in this update!

Thank you.

[b][ Appnori Inc. ][/b]

The server selection UI has been removed and all servers have been integrated. Enjoy faster and more convenient multiplayer matchmaking.

The trophy feature in the lobby has been improved. Check out the new look of your trophies!

The wait time for random multiplayer matchmaking has been removed, allowing you to start games more quickly.

We always value your feedback and strive to provide a better gaming environment. We hope this update enhances your gaming experience even further. As always, we welcome your opinions and suggestions.
